I've consolidated the hourly windows for Nov 24–26 and attached a sample CSV (hourly_spike_sample.csv). Findings (high-level):

Recommended actions:
- We can: (A) issue a retroactive credit for the two Holdings-attributed windows and reassign those tokens to SARL, or (B) provide a detailed export so your finance team can apply splits on their side. We typically prefer (A) for faster closure.
- Required evidence for credit: consolidated hourly CSV (attached), sample request-ids (in CSV), and your confirmation of target entity (SARL).
- VAT/tax note: credits will be issued as an invoice credit note. For EU VAT treatment we will include an explanatory accounting line referencing the original invoice and the amendment; please confirm whether Acme prefers a reverse-charge note or a corrected VAT-bearing credit (we can coordinate with your EU tax team).

Attachments: hourly_spike_sample.csv (columns: hour_utc, token_count, request_id_sample, attributed_entity)
